stem: What lesson does Cara learn from Grandpa?

options.label: A
options.text: Surprises can sometimes bring great joy to people.

options.label: B
options.text: Spending time with a grandparent is fun no matter what you do together.

options.label: C
options.text: Repairing old things to make them useful again can be rewarding.

options.label: D
options.text: Old things lose their meaning when they are made to look new again.
